# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Window and Application Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Displays "TaxReturn.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc"
  - Shows current date and time: "Oct 22 19:16"
  - Contains standard window controls: Minimize, Maximize, Close (on the right)
  - Left side shows "Activities" label

- **Application Menu Bar**
  - Contains standard menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar and Formatting Controls

- **Main Toolbar**
  - Contains icons for common actions: New, Open, Save, Print, Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, Find, Replace, Font Color, Background Color, etc.
  - Includes formatting tools: Font selection dropdown (currently "Calibri"), Font size dropdown (currently "11 pt"), Bold, Italic, Underline, Text Color, Background Color, Alignment, Borders, Number formatting, and more.

- **Formula Bar**
  - Displays current cell reference: "B4"
  - Shows current cell value: "1200000"
  - Contains formula input area with operators: "f.", "Σ", "=", and a dropdown arrow

## Document Content Area

- **Worksheet Grid**
  - Grid of cells with column headers A through R and row numbers 1 through 36 visible
  - Cell B4 is currently selected and highlighted with a red border
  - Cell B4 contains the value "$1,200,000"

- **Worksheet Data**
  - **Title**: "Corporate Tax Return - 2024" located in cell B3

    - Row 4: "Product Sales" with value "$1,200,000" in cell B4

    - Row 8: "Total Revenue" with value "$1,715,000" in cell B8
  - **Expenses Section** (Rows 10-20)
    - Row 10: "Expenses" as a header
    - Row 11: "COGS" with value "$600,000" in cell B11
    - Row 12: "Salaries" with value "$400,000" in cell B12
    - Row 13: "Rent" with value "$120,000" in cell B13

    - Row 15: "R&D" with value "$150,000" in cell B15
    - Row 16: "Depreciation" with value "$50,000" in cell B16
    - Row 17: "Travel" with value "$20,000" in cell B17
    - Row 18: "Utilities" with value "$30,000" in cell B18
    - Row 19: "Other Expenses" with value "$15,000" in cell B19
    - Row 20: "Total Expenses" with value "$1,465,000" in cell B20
  - **Tax Calculation Section** (Rows 22-24)
    - Row 22: "Taxable Income" with value "250000" in cell B22
    - Row 23: "Tax Rate" with value "21.00%" in cell B23
    - Row 24: "Tax Liability" with value "52500" in cell B24

## Sidebar and Additional UI Elements

- **Sidebar (Right Side)**
  - Contains vertical toolbar with icons for:
    - Format Painter
    - Chart
    - Pivot Table
    - Function Wizard (fx)
    - Other formatting and data tools

- **Status Bar (Bottom)**
  - Displays sheet name: "TaxReturn"
  - Shows page style: "PageStyle_TaxReturn"
  - Language setting: "English (Hong Kong)"
  - Statistics: "Average: $1,200,000; Sum: $
